    } else if (divisibleBy3) {
      print("Fizz");
      count++;
    } else if (divisibleBy5) {
      print("Buzz");
      count++;
    } else {
      print(i);
    }
  }
  return count;
}

String antiShuffle(String s) {
  if (s.isEmpty || s.length == 1) return s;
  
  List<String> words = [];
  int i = 0;
  while (i < s.length) {
    // Find the end of a word
    int j = i + 1;
    while (j < s.length && !isWhitespace(s[j])) {
      j++;
    }
    String word = s.substring(i, j);
    words.add(word);
    i = j;
  }

  // Reverse the list and join with spaces
  return words.reversed.join(' ');
}

bool isWhitespace(String c) => c.trim().isEmpty;
